places.name: Zócalo
places.ai_summary: The main square of Mexico City, surrounded by historic buildings and a hub of cultural and political activity.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for a vibrant atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Explore the surrounding historic buildings and enjoy street performances.

places.name: Palacio de Bellas Artes
places.ai_summary: A stunning cultural center featuring art exhibitions, concerts, and the iconic murals of Diego Rivera.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the murals on the upper floors.
places.address: Palacio de Bellas Artes, Mexico City, Mexico

places.name: Chapultepec Castle
places.ai_summary: A historic castle located in Chapultepec Park, offering panoramic views of the city and a museum of history.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for the uphill walk to the castle.

places.name: Museo Nacional de Antropología
places.ai_summary: One of the most important museums of anthropology in the world, featuring artifacts from Mexico's pre-Columbian heritage.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays.

places.place_tip: Visit the Aztec Calendar and the giant stone heads.
places.address: Paseo de la Reforma, Mexico City, Mexico

places.name: Frida Kahlo Museum (Casa Azul)
places.ai_summary: The former home of artist Frida Kahlo, now a museum dedicated to her life and work.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays.

places.place_tip: Book tickets in advance to avoid long lines.
places.address: Londres 247, Del Carmen, Coyoacán, 04100 Ciudad de México, CDMX, Mexico

places.name: Templo Mayor
places.ai_summary: The main temple of the Aztecs in their capital city Tenochtitlan, now an archaeological site and museum.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays.

places.place_tip: Visit the museum to understand the history of the site.

attribution.description: Symbol of the Alcaldía Cuauhtémoc, Mexico City

places.name: Catedral Metropolitana
places.ai_summary: The largest cathedral in the Americas, located on the Zócalo, showcasing stunning architecture and historical artifacts.

opening_hours.notes: Mass schedules may affect visiting hours.

places.place_tip: Attend a mass to experience the cathedral's atmosphere.

places.name: Xochimilco Canals
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage site, famous for its colorful boats and floating gardens, offering a glimpse into Mexico's pre-Hispanic past.
places.name_english: Xochimilco Ecological Park and Plant Market

opening_hours.notes: Best visited on weekends for the full market experience.

places.place_tip: Negotiate boat prices and explore the floating gardens.

places.name: Teotihuacán Pyramids (day trip)
places.ai_summary: Ancient Mesoamerican pyramids located outside of Mexico City, a popular day trip destination to explore the Pyramid of the Sun and the Pyramid of the Moon.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited early in the morning to avoid crowds.

places.place_tip: Climb the pyramids for a stunning view of the archaeological site.

places.name: Soumaya Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum with a striking modern architecture, housing a vast collection of art, including works by Mexican and European masters.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Wednesdays.

places.place_tip: Check for temporary exhibitions and cultural events.

places.name: Torre Latinoamericana
places.ai_summary: A landmark skyscraper in Mexico City, offering an observation deck with panoramic views of the city.

opening_hours.notes: Last elevator at 9:00 PM.

places.place_tip: Buy tickets online to skip the line.

places.ai_summary: A vibrant neighborhood known for its bohemian atmosphere, colonial architecture, and as the home of Frida Kahlo.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for a lively atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Explore the local markets and try street food.

places.name: Reforma Avenue & Angel of Independence
places.ai_summary: A major thoroughfare in Mexico City, known for its wide sidewalks, historic monuments, and the iconic Angel of Independence statue.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby museums and parks.
places.address: Paseo de la Reforma, Mexico City, Mexico

places.ai_summary: A traditional market in Mexico City, famous for its wide variety of Mexican foods, ingredients, and local delicacies.
places.cost: Free entry, pay for what you consume

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning for fresh produce.

places.place_tip: Try the local cheeses and meats.

places.name: Basilica of Our Lady of Guadalupe
places.ai_summary: A famous pilgrimage site, featuring a basilica that houses the cloak of Juan Diego, who reportedly saw an apparition of the Virgin Mary.

opening_hours.notes: Mass schedules may affect visiting hours.

places.place_tip: Attend a mass for a spiritual experience.
places.address: Basilica de Guadalupe, Mexico City, Mexico

places.place_tip: Check for temporary exhibitions.

places.place_tip: Visit the museums and enjoy a boat ride in the park.
